summary.ko: 유입부터 행동까지의 단계·수치·마찰을 연결해 개선 가설을 우선순위화합니다.
summary.en: Connect funnel stages, evidence, and friction points to prioritized improvement hypotheses.

exclusions: Campaign reporting without a funnel question

required_inputs.description: Funnel stages, audience, and intended conversion
Available aggregate metrics, page evidence, and known tracking limitations

workflow.instruction: Define stage entry, completion, units, time window, and denominator before comparing conversion rates.
Reconcile supplied counts and flag missing events, inconsistent attribution, or non-comparable cohorts.
Connect measured drop-offs with observed messaging or interaction friction without asserting unproven causation.
Prioritize hypotheses by evidence, expected impact, and effort, and propose an appropriate validation test.

deliverables.name: Funnel review
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains stage definitions, verified calculations, evidence gaps, and ranked hypotheses

deliverables.name: Improvement backlog
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each hypothesis includes supporting evidence, proposed change, and validation method

limitations: Correlation and drop-off do not identify cause by themselves.
Aggregate counts cannot establish individual journeys or cross-device identity.
permission_boundaries: Do not change tracking, deploy experiments, or alter checkout and pricing.
Do not request identifiable customer records when aggregate data suffices.
